text: イワヤマ　トンネル　ぬけて　シオン　タウンに　いく　ところ　なんだ　けど…

structure.jp: イワヤマ　トンネル　ぬけて
シオン　タウンに　いく　ところ　なんだ
structure.en: I'm just about to go to Lavender Town

patterns.name: 〜ところだ
patterns.span: いく　ところ　なんだ
patterns.explanation: A plain verb plus ところ means 'just about to do it'. いく　ところ　なんだ = 'I'm just about to go, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form of a verb joins one action to the next: 'does this and then that'. トンネル　ぬけて = 'go through the tunnel and'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ gives the feeling of explaining your situation, and it needs な in front after a thing-word. It is the spoken short form of のだ. ところ　なんだ = 'the thing is, I'm about to'.
